Pune starter guide

For your first two weeks

🚌 Getting to Hinjewadi

PMPML buses run to the IT parks; Pune Metro Line 3 (Hinjewadi–Shivajinagar) is being built. Many people use a scooty or office cabs. Mornings 8:30–10:30 are the slowest.

🍛 Food

Monthly mess or tiffin plans are common near PGs. Try a week first before paying for a month.

📄 Papers you'll need

Your registered rent agreement works as address proof for a bank account and SIM card. Police verification is required for tenants in Pune; we handle it in the app.

🌧️ Weather

Monsoon runs roughly June to September. Keep a raincoat on your scooty; some underpasses flood in heavy rain.
